note: Tester A 27.11.2026 (dzienny przebieg na prośbę właściciela): THE SHOWROOM Festive Edition (pop-up moda i kosmetyki w Galeries Lafayette) to zakupy – odrzucone. Challenge Peak: prawdziwa data 5.12 (nie 12.12) i miejsce Abu Dhabi Cricket & Sports Hub. Masfout X Rowing to wioślarstwo na ergometrach. Uzupełnione brakujące opisy (strony organizatorów; dla stron z zakazem robots i Fever – opisy ogólne z prasy).

set.description: Challenge Peak is a time-capped fitness race that tests endurance and strength over a multi-stage course, from the opening run to the final rowing metres. Registration closes on 5 December or when places sell out.

set.title: Masfout X Indoor Rowing Championship
set.description: Indoor rowing championship on rowing machines, part of the Masfout X events in Masfout, Ajman. Open men's and women's categories; free registration and cash prizes for the top finishers.
Indian comedy star Aakash Gupta performs his stand-up show Daily Ka Kaam Hai at the New Covent Garden Theatre, with shows at 17:00 and 20:30.
Arabian Tale is a kids and family show at TODA in Dubai on Saturday 28 November; doors open at 11:30 and the show starts at noon.
MOTN winter festival on the Abu Dhabi Corniche: rides, immersive adventures, live music and shows, food from around the world and shopping, daily 4 pm–11:30 pm.
Malayalam rapper Vedan performs live in Abu Dhabi with Kuthanthram, featuring Sushin Shyam; doors open at 4 pm and the concert starts at 6:30 pm.
Celebrate Christmas Eve Italian-style at Cinque with a four-course festive dinner from 7 pm.
Christmas Day brunch at ENVY, Th8 Palm Dubai: a festive beachfront feast with family and friends from 1 pm to 5 pm.
FightGecko Combat Series 4: a night of professional combat-sports fights at W Dubai – The Palm; doors open at 5 pm, first fight at 6 pm.
Bollywood playback singer Kumar Sanu performs his best-known film songs live at Sheikh Rashid Hall, Dubai World Trade Centre.

Second edition of the Al Ain International Hunting & Equestrian Exhibition (AAIHEX) at ADNEC Centre Al Ain: falconry, equestrianism, hunting and outdoor pursuits for enthusiasts and families, 10 am–10 pm.
Children's Biennale art exhibition, part of the Abu Dhabi Festival, with artworks shown outdoors in Umm Al Emarat Park; free admission (park entry may apply).
Season-long heritage and entertainment festival at Al Wathba with pavilions from around the world, Emirati heritage, shows, car events, food and fireworks.
Speciality coffee brand 22:22 takes over Raffles Salon for a month with a dedicated coffee bar, a curated collection and small coffee-tasting experiences.
Interactive Children's Museum exhibition at Louvre Abu Dhabi about board games from around the world and across 5,000 years, with games to play; included in the museum ticket.
Interactive courtroom show: the audience is the jury, hears the evidence and witnesses in the case of a deadly boat ride, and votes on the verdict.
Festival on the Abu Dhabi Corniche celebrating Emirati coastal heritage: traditional boats, fishing and pearling crafts, folk performances, traditional games and food.
Second Public Art Abu Dhabi Biennial: large outdoor artworks by local and international artists installed across the city and emirate, free to visit.
Guided walking tours of the Public Art Abu Dhabi Biennial artworks around Souq Al Mina in Mina Zayed, with a guide explaining the works and artists.
Candlelight concert at Emirates Palace: live musicians play Coldplay and Imagine Dragons hits by the light of hundreds of candles.
